comment: M05 alpha gate and M05R review round: real cities on classic RWG, seed 4242 (no oceans, so no monument). Each shot's position and view come from /lostcities find (decision log D115); M05R adds the rise cap's view; M12 adds the taper, lot, repair and feather views (docs/design/0010, 0009).
title: Alpha review: real cities on classic RWG, seed 4242

shots.name: above
shots.caption: City from above: the city nearest the spawn, from south of its center, looking north.

shots.name: street
shots.caption: Street level: the primary street nearest the spawn with open street ahead, from head height.

shots.name: interior
shots.caption: Building interior: the ground floor of the building nearest the spawn, looking toward its street door.

shots.name: edge
shots.caption: City edge: where the city meets classic RWG terrain, from just above the land outside it, looking into the city.

shots.name: rise
shots.caption: Rise cap: the city street nearest the spawn beside classic RWG ground at least 12 blocks above it, from above the city looking at the slope. The city stops or steps down here instead of climbing it (AR-4).

shots.name: village
shots.caption: Village sewn into the city: a village's gate where the city's lane meets it, seen from beside the lane, the city on one side and the village on the other. The clearest of every gate within 200 chunks of the spawn (flattest ground, city and village at one height); the nearest village sits on a mountainside.

shots.name: reserved
shots.caption: Reserved lot: the core of the same village as the village shot, the natural ground the city leaves to it, seen from inside the city across the margin.

shots.name: softedge
shots.caption: Soft edge: the city's margin, a chunk of natural ground the blend slopes from the city's edge to a village's ground, with the strip that meets the village's own edge and the lane's steps; the city builds inside it (AR-10, AR-11).

shots.name: taper
shots.caption: Tapering (AR-5): the city nearest the spawn from 48 blocks beyond its radius, low over the land; heights rise organically from low buildings and lots at the edge to the high-rise core.

shots.name: lot
shots.caption: Edge lot (AR-6): the nearest empty or construction lot at a city's edge, bare clay and dirt with nothing growing; excavations are dug 1, 2 or 4 blocks, foundations carry concrete columns.

shots.name: repair
shots.caption: Partial repair (AR-9): a building an explosion reached whose damage was partly filled back in with a similar but not identical material, its windows boarded.

shots.name: feather
shots.caption: Color feathering (AR-17): two neighboring buildings of different city styles; their facades stay within the contrast limit, no pale building beside a dark saturated one.
